_comment: The Delectable Mountains examination. The Shepherds ask the pilgrim to say back what he learned in the Valley; the right answer is only offered to a player who actually stood against the accuser (flag defeated_apollyon / stood_against_accuser).

start.speaker: Shepherd Experience
start.text: Before we lend you our glass, tell us something. In the Valley, the destroyer told you a lie. Name it — and name what answered it.
start.text_zh: 在我们把望远镜借给你之前，先说一件事。在山谷里，那毁坏者对你说了一个谎。说出来——再说出是什么回答了它。

choices.text: He said I was still his. The answer was that I had been bought, and not by him.
choices.text_zh: 他说我仍旧属他。答案是：我已经被赎了，而且赎我的不是他。

choices.text: He told me what I was worth. He was counting the wrong things.
choices.text_zh: 他告诉我我值多少。他数错了东西。

choices.text: I do not remember what he said. Only that I was still standing afterwards.
choices.text_zh: 我不记得他说了什么。只记得那之后我还站着。

choices.text: I beat him. Does the rest matter?
choices.text_zh: 我胜了他。其余的还重要吗？

well.speaker: Shepherd Knowledge
well.text_zh: 牧人彼此看了一眼。「他记得的是那句话，不是那一仗。」——望远镜递到你手里，镜身还带着别人的体温。

partly.speaker: Shepherd Knowledge
partly.text_zh: 「站住已经不容易了。」牧人说，「不过下一次，记住他说了什么——你会需要那句话的反面。」

gently.speaker: Shepherd Watchful
gently.text_zh: 「胜了的人常常忘了自己是怎么胜的。」牧人把望远镜递过来，手却慢了一拍，「前面的路上，你会想起我这句话。」
